cards.text: Jesus has just come through forty days in the wilderness, and the devil finally left Him (Matthew 4:1-11). Then the news hits. John the Baptist, the man who baptized Him, has been put in prison (Matthew 3:13-16).

cards.question: When Jesus hears that John the Baptist has been put in prison, what does He do?

answers.text: He heads back to the wilderness

cards.text: Jesus leaves Nazareth and moves to a town right by the sea. My last move? Carried across a kitchen, dropped in a junk drawer, and the welcome committee was a dead battery and a twist tie.

cards.question: Jesus leaves Nazareth and goes to live in ___, a town by the sea.

cards.text: Capernaum sits in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali. Matthew says this move fulfills what the prophet Isaiah said about that land, and Isaiah's words talk about people living in darkness.

cards.question: Isaiah said that in the land of Zebulun and Naphtali, the people living in darkness have seen a great ___.

cards.text: And on those living in the land of the shadow of death, Isaiah says, a light has dawned. Friend, I spent YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, so trust me, I know exactly what it means when the light finally pours in.

cards.question: From that time on, Jesus begins to preach this message: "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near."

cards.text: One day Jesus is walking beside the Sea of Galilee. He sees two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew, casting a net into the sea, because they're fishermen.

cards.question: Jesus tells the fishermen Simon Peter and Andrew to come follow Him, and says He will make them ___ of men.
Jesus has just invited the fishermen Simon Peter and Andrew to follow Him. How do they answer?

answers.text: They leave their nets at once
They finish the day's catch first
They ask for time to think

cards.text: Going on from there, Jesus sees two more brothers: James son of Zebedee and his brother John, a different John from the Baptist. They're sitting in a boat mending their nets, and they've got company in there.

cards.question: James and John are in a boat mending their nets. Who's in the boat with them?
When Jesus calls James and John, they leave the boat and their father right away and follow Him.

cards.text: Four fishermen drop EVERYTHING the second He calls, and I need four alarms just to let go of my pillow. Now Jesus goes throughout Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom.

cards.question: As Jesus travels throughout Galilee, where does He teach?
As Jesus goes through Galilee, He heals only some of the diseases and sickness among the people.

cards.text: News about Him spreads all over Syria. People bring Him everyone who's ill: all kinds of diseases, severe pain, the demon-possessed, seizures and the paralyzed.

cards.question: People bring Jesus the sick, the suffering and the demon-possessed. What does He do?
The large crowds following Jesus come only from Galilee.

findings.problem: Papa Dorin calls the junk drawer his 'last move.' In his backstory, his most recent move was out of the drawer and into the Dorinverse, so this line contradicts his story. Reword it, for example as 'My worst move' or 'One move I'll never forget.'

rule.text: His own world isn't Bible fact. His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them.

findings.problem: No story card sets up Jesus beginning to preach. Card 7 ends on Isaiah's light, and card 8 jumps straight to a true or false statement of Jesus' message. The baker has no context to reason from, so the pick is a coin flip. Jesus' first message is also one of the passage's key moments. It needs a story card that moves the passage from Isaiah's words to 'From that time on,' Jesus starting to preach, and then a question the baker can reason out.

rule.text: Before each choice card, Papa Dorin's story card gives enough context that the baker can reason their way to the answer.

findings.problem: Card 12 introduces 'James son of Zebedee' and then says 'they've got company in there.' Card 13 asks who is in the boat, and the right answer is 'Their father Zebedee.' The name Zebedee was already given, and it appears only in the right answer, so card 12 gives that answer away. Either introduce James and John without the father's name and hold it for the answer, or ask a different question about this moment.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
